scientific_stage: M2-B5 blind joint propagation of the frozen M2-A4 provider portfolios
purpose: Complete the frozen M2 semantics by propagating the full 3x3x3 Cartesian product of independently confirmed diverse I1-compatible provider surrogates through the native graph, then aggregate an equal-weight ensemble mean and finite-portfolio ambiguity range before any graph white-box evaluation.

variant_design.m2_joint_portfolio: Enumerate every tuple (theta_Aj, theta_Bk, theta_Cl) from the three frozen A4 portfolios.
variant_design.m1_baseline: Run BASE_M1 on the same fresh graph seed bank for paired reference only.

graph_query.rho_policy: same-rho diagonal retained from the frozen current pilot
graph_query.A_G_construction: Use the same public-I1-induced G0 admissibility boundary for every M2 joint member and BASE_M1 at each rho.
graph_query.horizon_support: read from the frozen public I1 cards
graph_query.rho_support: read from the frozen public I1 same-rho support
graph_query.Jaccard_D_A: N/A because A_G is controlled and identical across variants

required_member_outputs: one request ledger per simulated variant
one sigma_G curve per M2 joint member
BASE_M1 sigma_G curve on the same seed bank

required_ensemble_outputs.central_prediction: equal-weight arithmetic mean over the 27 M2 joint sigma_G values
required_ensemble_outputs.ambiguity_lower: minimum sigma_G across the 27 M2 joint values
required_ensemble_outputs.ambiguity_upper: maximum sigma_G across the 27 M2 joint values

monte_carlo_uncertainty.recommended_followup: Use seed-cluster bootstrap on the per-seed trajectory pass indicators if a pointwise Monte Carlo band around the ensemble mean is reported. Resample graph seed indices jointly across all 27 M2 members because common random numbers induce cross-member dependence.

freeze_order.step_1: Load and verify the frozen semantic contract and frozen A4 candidate set.
freeze_order.step_2: Materialize and write the complete 27-member joint design before simulation.
freeze_order.step_3: Run all graph simulations on the fresh CRN seed bank and checkpoint ledgers.
freeze_order.step_4: Compute every member sigma_G curve and BASE_M1 curve.
freeze_order.step_5: Aggregate the 27-member equal-weight mean and finite-portfolio min-max range.
freeze_order.step_6: Write hashes/manifest that freeze all B5 predictions and aggregates while graph white-box remains unread.
freeze_order.step_7: Only a later external-evaluation stage may open graph white-box.

interpretation_guardrails: The M2 ensemble mean is an equal-weight central estimate over deliberately diverse representatives, not a posterior expectation.
The M2 min-max band is a finite-portfolio ambiguity range, not a statistical confidence interval and not a proven global bound over all I1-compatible theta.
Do not identify a post-hoc best member as the operational M2 prediction.
Do not modify portfolio members, weights, or rho/A_G policy after graph white-box inspection.
Do not compare B5 against graph white-box inside the B5 runner.
next_gate: After B5 prediction freeze, inspect the blind M2 ensemble mean/range internally for consistency only. Then define a separate B6 external white-box evaluation contract. Because G0 white-box has already been seen during method development, B6 on G0 is retrospective diagnostic evidence; prospective validation requires an untouched condition.
